children: AutoZone's gross margin expanded to 53.3% in fiscal fourth quarter 2026, up 182 basis points from a year earlier, driven by tariff refunds, which contributed 145 basis points to the gain. A 105 basis point benefit from non-cash LIFO adjustments also helped offset pressure from higher commercial sales mix. The improvement came even as operating expenses increased to 33.4% of sales from 32.4% a year ago, with the company attributing the deleverage to spending on growth initiatives
